exposure: Proactive lactation consultant telephone advice/contact in the first month postpartum
cohort: Postpartum mothers (n=765), including those with co-morbidities (e.g., obese, depression) and those with infants admitted to the NNU, were observed for breastfeeding status.
finding: Proactive early lactation advice significantly prolonged exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) rates for up to 6 months, enhancing infant nutrition overall, including for mothers at risk of early cessation.
mod_finding: Exclusive breastfeeding rates in the exposure group were higher across the 6 months for all birth modes.
